message.reasoning: The user asks: "response metric counts weekends?" They want to know if the response metric counts weekends. According to policy excerpt: By default, the response-time metric counts every hour a ticket sits unanswered, including nights, weekends and holidays. So answer: yes, by default it counts weekends. Also mention business hours mode can exclude weekends. Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"Yes – by default the response‑time metric counts every hour a ticket sits unanswered, including nights, weekends and holidays.
